note: ESTIMATES for the car's weight and balance (VEHICLE step 4). Every mass here is an estimate typed for a typical car of the class, NOT read from a source and NOT checked against one. Each entry names what it stands for in its note. The real cars' masses and front splits are in real_cars.json (compared, not used to set these).
fuel_note: estimate: petrol at about 0.74 kg per litre (the density used for the fill)
driver_note: estimate: a 75 kg rider, used when the fighter's body has no mass of its own
tyre_note: estimate: a tyre's mass from its size, 6.7e-5 kg per mm2 of (width x diameter); 225/45R17 gives about 9.5 kg
rim_note: estimate: one alloy rim, 6 kg, at the same centre as its tyre
steel_note: steel: 7850 kg/m3 (the density of mild steel, as the chassis step uses)

engine.name: Engine + gearbox
engine.note: estimate: a 1.5 L petrol engine with its gearbox

drive_unit.name: Electric drive unit
drive_unit.note: estimate: an electric motor with its reduction gear

ev_pack.name: EV battery pack
ev_pack.note: estimate: a battery pack of about 50 to 60 kWh, under the floor

seat.name: Seats
seat.note: estimate: one seat frame, cushion and belts; the count is per class

cargo.name: Cargo
cargo.note: your load: set it with the slider (0 by default)

City.note: estimate: a city car's tank and seats

Hatch.note: estimate: a hatchback's tank and seats

Sedan.note: estimate: a saloon's tank and seats

SUV.note: estimate: an SUV's tank and seats

Roadster.note: estimate: a two-seat roadster's tank and seats

tank_note: estimate: the empty tank shell, pipes and pump, 8 kg
